entities.summary: Jordan Blackmon Montgomery, nicknamed "Gumby" or "Monty", is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Texas Rangers of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the New York Yankees, St. Louis Cardinals, and Arizona Diamondbacks.
